calibration_sources: RFC 5549 (Advertising IPv4 Network Layer Reachability Information with an IPv6 Next Hop) & RFC 7938 (BGP in Large-Scale Data Centers)
SONiC / NVIDIA Cumulus Linux / Arista AI Fabric BGP Unnumbered, Hardware BFD & WCMP (Link-Bandwidth Community) Reference Designs
Meta & Microsoft RoCEv2 Rail-Optimized Clos Underlay & Asymmetric Link Failure WCMP Benchmarks

workload.cluster_topology: 2,048-GPU Rail-Optimized RoCEv2 Fabric (256 Nodes × 8 NICs, 8 Rail Planes, 64 Leaf Switches, 32 Spine Switches, 4,096 × 400G/800G Links)
workload.failure_scenario: Single 400G/800G Leaf-to-Spine optical transceiver flap & asymmetric 31/32 uplink degradation during 2,048-GPU synchronous AllReduce
workload.nccl_timeout_threshold: NCCL IB/RoCE QP retry exhaustion (~4.2s–18s) & Watchdog Timeout (30s–180s) if routing blackhole persists

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统二层大 VLAN / MLAG + 默认 BGP Hold-Timer 180s (链路闪断必崩 NCCL ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Legacy L2 VLAN / MLAG + Default 180s BGP Hold-Timer (Guaranteed NCCL Timeout on Link Flap)
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy enterprise office networks only; fatal for >64-GPU RoCEv2 fabrics (PFC + L2 flood loops and 95s blackholes).

tiers.name: Tier 2: 手工静态 /31 IPv4 eBGP Clos + 等权 ECMP (8,192 个手工 IP，断 1 根上联即拥塞)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Manual /31 Point-to-Point IPv4 eBGP Clos + Equal-Cost ECMP (8,192 Manual IPs, Asymmetry Bottleneck)
tiers.recommended_for: Small static clusters; suffers from manual /31 IP typos, BGP path hunting, and Equal-ECMP overloading degraded Leafs.

tiers.name: Tier 3: RFC 5549 BGP Unnumbered + 轨道独立 ASN + 300ms BFD (零互联 IP + 消除路径狩猎)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: RFC 5549 BGP Unnumbered + Rail-Independent ASN + 300ms BFD (Zero P2P IPs, No Path Hunting)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard single-tenant SONiC / Cumulus AI clusters seeking zero-touch ZTP cabling and clean Rail-plane ASN isolation.

tiers.name: Tier 4: BGP Unnumbered + 硬件 15ms BFD + Link-Bandwidth WCMP 加权路由 + EVPN 多租户
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: BGP Unnumbered + Hardware 15ms BFD + Link-Bandwidth WCMP + EVPN Multi-Tenant VRF
tiers.recommended_for: Production 512–32,768 GPU AI clouds: converges in 18.5ms (within IB/RoCE QP retry window) and retains 96.4% AllReduce BW via WCMP.
